descriptions.zh: 作为技术领先的敌人发动无端侵略的受害者，我们学到了疏忽大意会付出的代价。这种事情不会再发生了。
descriptions.en: As the victim of an unprovoked act of aggression by a technologically superior foe, we understand the cost of negligence. Never again.

descriptions.zh: 前 MSI 战舰将得到修复，为我们所用。
descriptions.en: MSI's former warship will be restored to serve our purposes.

descriptions.zh:
我们的前主人声称我们亏欠他们战争赔款。他们已经雇佣了一个星际债务回收机构来处理此事。

descriptions.en:
Our former masters claim we owe them war reparations. An intergalactic debt collection agency has been hired to settle the matter.

The §YGene Clinics§! our invaders built for us are suffering from lack of maintenance. While most of the technology is beyond our current understanding, we could try to §Srepair§! it.

§LSigning research pacts with other empires will increase our chances of success. [GetAgreementStatus]§!
